speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Strategy Group will continue to lead the Public Service to develop and implement strategic priorities, tackle long-term national challenges and build a better Singapore for all.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: During our engagements, many shared their desire to build a fairer, more inclusive and more caring society.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Beyond Forward Singapore, the Strategy Group will continue to strengthen whole-of-Government planning and execution to effectively tackle increasingly complex and cross-cutting challenges.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: These include a fragmented global order amid rising geopolitical tensions, new challenges brought about by technology, and the ongoing need to help Singaporeans cope with greater disruption and change.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: In response to this rapidly changing environment, the Strategy Group will review and refresh Singapore’s medium- to long-term national priorities, and work with Government agencies to strengthen the resilience of our economy, society and nation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Amidst growing resource constraints, we will also support agencies by centrally developing capabilities and coordinating structures across the Public Service.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will organise cross-agency work on policy development and implementation, to better manage trade-offs and achieve our desired outcomes across both economic and social domains.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our local workforce growth will continue to slow.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Caregiving needs will intensify as family sizes shrink and more Singaporeans face dual pressures of raising young children while caring for their elderly parents.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our society is also becoming more diverse and our multicultural identify will continue to evolve.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will update our population strategies to tackle these challenges.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: First, we will do more to harness longevity as a strength, so that individuals can reap the benefits of longer and healthier lives.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will do more to support the marriage and parenthood aspirations of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Government has announced a package of pro-family measures at Budget 2023.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Strategy Group will continue to review and update our policies, including ways to extend more help to parents caring for their infants, and to those seeking to better manage their work and family commitments.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Beyond Government measures, the whole of society has to come together to develop an environment that supports families and values family well-being.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Government will continue to work with the community, employers and other stakeholders to build a Singapore Made For Families.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Amid the rising urgency to reduce global greenhouse gas emissions, we will push ahead with efforts to mitigate and adapt to climate change.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: All stakeholders must work together as we transition to a more resilient and sustainable society.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will diversify our energy mix with greener alternatives, such as hydrogen and regional renewable energy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will work with industry and other stakeholders to research, develop and deploy low-carbon climate technologies, such as carbon capture, utilisation and storage.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will build a pipeline of high-quality carbon credit projects to help meet our climate goals.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also support Singapore’s industries to embrace green opportunities and develop a workforce ready for the green economy of the future.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: At the same time, we must be prepared for the worst.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Government will also continue to participate actively at the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and other international platforms to help shape the global climate regime, build partnerships and share expertise and climate solutions with the international community.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Government’s ability to think ahead and plan for the long term is key in ensuring Singapore’s continued survival and success.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to strengthen forward planning capabilities across the Government.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will work with Singaporeans to achieve a better Singapore that will endure and thrive for generations to come.
